G_CAL.margin_pit_deviation: Randomized PIT of realized margins; decile histogram frequencies pooled; PASS if max |frequency - 0.1| <= 0.05
G_CAL.standard: Both sub-checks must pass; computed on the candidate PMF
G_CAL.total_pit_slope: Randomized PIT of realized game totals (randomization stream: PCG64 seeded from the attempt-2 root seed and the game_id); decile reliability slope = OLS slope of observed vs expected cumulative fraction at decile midpoints 0.05..0.95, pooled over folds; PASS if slope in [0.9, 1.1]

G_JOINT.baseline_i: league empirical score PMF from the training window (realized final scores, same floor)

baseline_ii_frozen_discrete_v2_grid.scope: Prospective-stage requirement ONLY (removed from the development gate per ruling J1): at the prospective stage the candidate must also beat the frozen discrete_v2 grid under the prospective gate's own rules. At development the leg cannot pass or fail the gate, is not waived, and is not deferred-passed; no development PASS may be represented as having satisfied it. The external-benchmark obligation remains outstanding after any development result.

baseline_ii_prime_independent_marginals.definition: Per game, the home and away marginal PMFs of the game's candidate joint PMF (post-K3) composed independently: P(h, a) = P^H(h) * P^A(a); realized scores scored under the composed PMF with the same floor rule
baseline_ii_prime_independent_marginals.governance: Per ruling J1 and Amendment 1: a dependence-value test derived from the candidate's own PMF - NOT an independent external benchmark; no external benchmark is evaluated in the development window and the development record must not present it as one

G_JOINT.metric: mean log score of realized scores under the simulated PMF (50,000 paths, preregistered floor)
G_JOINT.standard: candidate must beat BOTH legs, pooled AND in >=3/5 folds, per leg; G-JOINT passes iff both legs pass

G_KEY.standard: pooled |model P(margin = k) - realized frequency| <= 0.0075 at EACH key, computed on the candidate (post-K3) PMF; the skeleton PMF's key errors are computed identically and reported as diagnostics

G_PERIOD.baseline: period league empirical score PMF from the training window

families.QUARTER: joint (home, away) per-quarter points, pooled over quarters 1-4

G_PERIOD.inheritance: NONE - period verdicts neither affect nor are affected by the full-game verdict
G_PERIOD.metric: mean log score of realized period score pairs under the period simulated PMF (same floor rule)
G_PERIOD.standard: per family: candidate better pooled AND in >=3/5 folds

G_RARE.metric: pooled Poisson log score over all validation rows and folds
G_RARE.standard: candidate pooled log score >= baseline (no-harm), tolerance 1e-12

gates.fold_standard: Candidate better than baseline in >=3 of 5 folds AND pooled, unless a gate states otherwise
gates.full_game_verdict: PASS only if ALL of G_TD, G_FG, G_RARE, G_JOINT, G_CAL, G_KEY pass; period verdicts are independent in both directions

conversions.construction: Heritage per-row PIT beta-binomial probabilities (PAT / 2pt / none) carried on heritage rows; team-specific only at >=50 prior TDs, prior 25 TDs

dispersion.applies_to: Offensive-TD and made-FG simulation draws, full-game and per-quarter legs (each leg its own theta)
dispersion.no_recalibration: No Platt/isotonic/temperature adjustment; no post-simulation reshaping outside the frozen K3 component
dispersion.parameterization: Draw = NumPy negative_binomial(n = theta, p = theta / (theta + mu')) for finite theta, variance mu' + mu'^2 / theta; theta = Infinity is exactly the Poisson draw
dispersion.theta_selection: Per fold, per leg, inside the training window only: expanding-season CV, score = mean NB log-pmf of the realized leg count under the leg model's fitted mean over held-out training-season games; ties break to the larger theta

band_allocation.construction: Decayed-PIT accumulators per team (acc <- 0.85 * acc + counts per completed prior team-game, chronological, cross-season carry, initialized 0 at the 2018 window start); league accumulators are the sum over teams of accumulators including exactly team-games with kickoff strictly before the target kickoff (kickoff ties ordered by game_id; tied games never contribute to each other's inputs)
band_allocation.distance_field: kick_distance (as recorded; no derivation, no imputation)
band_allocation.league_share_b: league decayed attempts in band b / league decayed attempts all bands
band_allocation.team_share_b: (team decayed attempts in band b + 25 * league decayed share b) / (team decayed attempts all bands + 25)

conversion.league_rate_b: league decayed makes / league decayed attempts in band b; if a band's league attempts = 0, the pooled decayed league make rate over all bands; if that is also 0, ZERO_MODEL_ROW
conversion.team_rate_b: (team decayed makes in band b + 25 * league decayed rate b) / (team decayed attempts in band b + 25)

field_goals_banded.exclusions: Attempts with missing or non-positive kick_distance are excluded from shares, rates, and the opportunity target; excluded attempts and makes are counted per fold and overall and reported in the result record
field_goals_banded.gate_target: made_field_goals (ALL realized made FGs in the team-game)

opportunity.alpha_selection: Expanding-season CV inside the training window only, mean Poisson deviance on the opportunity target
opportunity.family: L2-regularized Poisson GLM (log link) on the 12 fg_opportunity_features
opportunity.target: fg_attempts_with_distance (attempts whose kick_distance is present and > 0)

key_number_component_k3.corner_rule: If a game's skeleton mass at key k is exactly 0 while its window mass is positive, no transfer occurs for that (game, key)
key_number_component_k3.estimator: Per fold f and key k: fit the fold count model on T_f; simulate the TRAINING games (50,000 paths each, same child-seed rule) for skeleton margin PMFs; S_bar_f(k) = mean per-game skeleton P(margin = k); R_f(k) = realized fraction of training games with final margin exactly k; lambda_hat_fk = clip((R_f(k) - S_bar_f(k)) / S_bar_f(W_k), 0, 0.50); if S_bar_f(W_k) = 0, lambda_hat = 0. One-directional: the component can only add key mass toward the training window's realized level. Estimation strictly precedes evaluation simulation within each fold.
key_number_component_k3.margin_zero: Never a key and never a source
key_number_component_k3.scope: Full-game joint distribution ONLY (period PMFs are not key-adjusted); estimated inside each training fold; applied uniformly to every game in the fold before any gate is computed; skeleton (pre-component) PMF preserved and reported
key_number_component_k3.status: Permitted by owner ruling K3; fully specified pre-fitting in preregistration section 4; part of the candidate model form
key_number_component_k3.transfer: For key k with fold parameter lambda_fk: every score pair with margin in W_k is multiplied by (1 - lambda_fk); the removed mass lambda_fk * S_g(W_k) is added to margin k in proportion to the game's skeleton probabilities at margin exactly k. Total probability conserved exactly; within-margin conditional composition is the skeleton's.

offensive_touchdowns.alpha_selection: Heritage expanding-season CV inside the training window only, metric mean Poisson deviance

period_model.dependence: ONE shared latent draw per simulated path across quarters; quarter draws conditionally independent given the latent (preregistered period-residual simplification). Halves are sums of their quarters on the same paths.
period_model.framework: Same count components + shared latent + conversion construction as the full-game model, with parameters fitted SEPARATELY for each quarter q in {1,2,3,4}; NB dispersion and restored alpha grid apply identically; period rare legs use the section 2.4 prior selection identically
period_model.no_inheritance: Period parameters, gates, and verdicts are independent of the full-game fit in both directions; attempt-1 period verdicts do not carry
period_model.second_half_scope: Regulation Q3+Q4 only; the pricer-side overtime settlement declaration remains production prerequisite P4, unresolved by this attempt.

rare_scores.construction: Heritage per-row PIT empirical-Bayes team rates (def_st_td_rate, safety_rate); Poisson draws at those rates (no NB dispersion on rare legs)
rare_scores.league_only_semantics: The candidate leg IS the training-window league-rate construction (the G-RARE baseline construction); G-RARE then passes by equality within tolerance, recorded as information, not a loophole
rare_scores.prior_selection: Per fold, expanding-season CV inside the training window only, on the rare-event Poisson log score
rare_scores.tie_break: Larger prior (LEAGUE_ONLY counts as largest - the most-shrunk, conservative direction)

shared_latent.role: Cross-team dependence only; sigma is not asked to do the dispersion work assigned to the count legs' theta
shared_latent.sigma_selection: AMENDED BY AMENDMENT 2 (section 6 governs): nested expanding-window selection INSIDE each outer fold's training window. Inner folds are formed within the training seasons (inner validation season = each training season after the first; inner models - refits of the fold's TD and banded-FG models at the fold's selected alpha values - are fitted on training seasons strictly before the inner validation season). Statistic: residual-product MSE in attempt-1 form (observed residual product vs mu_h * mu_a * (exp(sigma^2) - 1)) computed on inner out-of-fold residuals pooled across inner folds. Ties break to the smaller sigma. The selected sigma applies to its outer fold. Outer validation outcomes must never influence sigma. Fail-closed: a training window that cannot form at least one inner fold aborts pre-scoring as NOT_RUN; no fallback to validation data, ever.
shared_latent.superseded_attempt_1_placement: Heritage selection pooled the residual-product MSE over all five validation folds' rows through the fitted fold models and selected one shared sigma. That placement is attempt 1's historical procedure, superseded for attempt 2 by Amendment 2.

simulation.child_seed_rule: SHA-256 of '{root_seed_uint64}:{game_id}', first 8 bytes little-endian (attempt-1 construction)
simulation.pmf_floor: log score uses p_floor = 0.5 / paths_per_game for any realized score with zero simulated mass
